name: Mogami Aki
source:
[spoiler]Aki Mogami, birth name Minamoto no Yoshinaka, is a new character introduced in [url=/v20602]Majikoi! A-5[/url] and is an alternate love interest for Yamato Naoe in Yoshitsune's route. She receives her own route in [url=/v20604]Majikoi! A+[/url]. She is the Student Council Chairwoman that supports Kawakami Academy from the shadows. Aki was born for the purpose of being a rival for Yoshitsune. She plays a vital role in saving Kawakami City with Momoyo Kawakami, Seiso Hazakura and Tsubame Matsunaga in the Final Route. She is the former main antagonist in Yoshitsune's route, acting as the final enemy.

[From [url=https://majikoi.fandom.com/wiki/Aki_Mogami]Majikoi Wiki[/url]][/spoiler]
